1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Two glaze lifetimes are exposed by a forced opening walk before a compact generated core; the safe three-lantern route depends on which colour lasted longer.
1.natural_language: Gather every lantern and reach the door. Move only to an orthogonally adjacent tile. Leaving a tile lights its colour's fuse; every later move advances all lit fuses, and returning to a fallen tile fails. Watch the opening run crack behind you to learn the two colour lifetimes before choosing routes. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
